description: First payment of the referred tenant C, which shares a website domain with another referred tenant: the reward is created held.
note: The pending PaymentTransaction was inserted directly into the scratch database (the normal checkout, POST /api/v1/subscription/upgrade/initialize, calls the real Paystack API). The payload is shaped from what the handler reads (reference, channel, customer, authorization); it is NOT a captured Paystack delivery. It was signed with the same HMAC-SHA512 the endpoint verifies, using the local test PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY. The shared domain was set by writing tenants.widget_last_seen_host in the scratch database for the three referred tenants (the widget normally records it when it loads on the customer's site).
